en.headline: FEHD launches monthly allocation of over 1,600 public niches from tomorrow
en.dek: The enhanced arrangement replaces annual allocation and covers four columbaria; unsuccessful applicants for preferred sites will automatically be offered a niche at Tsang Tsui.
body: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department will implement a new enhanced monthly allocation arrangement for public niches starting on 1 August, fully replacing the previous annual allocation exercise.

More than 1,600 extendable public niches will be made available each month across four columbaria: Tsang Tsui Columbarium in Tuen Mun, Wo Hop Shek Columbarium Phase VI in Fanling, Cape Collinson-San Ha Columbarium in Chai Wan and Shek Mun Columbarium in Sha Tin.

A department spokesman said that if applications for a particular columbarium exceed the available quota, the FEHD will automatically allocate a niche at Tsang Tsui Columbarium to ensure every eligible applicant receives one. Applicants may choose whether to accept the automatically assigned niche. Those who decline it may re-apply for their preferred columbarium in a later monthly exercise. However, applicants who decline a niche allocated at their selected columbarium will not be accepted for the same deceased person at the same site for the next six months.

Applications can be submitted online or by form from 1 August. A computer ballot and drawing of lots will be held on the 20th of each month for applications received in the preceding month to determine allocation sequence and designated niches. The department encouraged online applications to avoid delays.

zh.headline: 食環署明日起每月編配逾1600個公眾骨灰龕位
zh.dek: 新安排全面取代周年編配，涵蓋四個靈灰安置所；未能獲選指定地點者將自動獲配曾咀龕位。
body: 食物環境衞生署由明日（8月1日）起實施優化後的公眾骨灰龕位每月編配安排，全面取代原有的周年編配。
每月合共提供逾1600個可續期公眾骨灰龕位，涵蓋屯門曾咀靈灰安置所、粉嶺和合石靈灰安置所第六期、柴灣哥連臣角新廈靈灰安置所及沙田石門靈灰安置所。
食環署發言人表示，如個別靈灰安置所的申請人數超過可供編配的龕位配額，署方會自動將龕位編配予曾咀靈灰安置所，確保每名合資格申請人在每月編配中均可獲配一個龕位。申請人可決定是否接受自動編配的曾咀龕位；若選擇不接受，可於其後的每月編配再次申請指定靈灰安置所。惟若申請人拒絕獲編配的指定靈灰安置所龕位，署方在其後六個月內不會再接受同一先人於同一靈灰安置所的申請。
市民可由8月1日起透過網上或表格提交申請。署方會於每月20日（如適逢星期六或公眾假期則順延至下一個工作天）就上月收到的合資格申請進行攪珠及電腦抽籤，以決定編配次序及指定龕位。署方鼓勵申請人優先以網上方式遞交申請，以免郵遞延誤。
